200.description: One entry per quoted tier, plus the tiers the network cannot serve.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the destination (for example America/Chicago), relayed from the delivery-promise quoted window. Read the window instants as local days and hours in this zone; absent for windows quoted without one, read those as UTC.

charge.description: A JSON document owned by the upstream contract; the BFF does not interpret it.
charge.title: Passthrough

freeOver.title: Passthrough

items.title: Passthrough

422.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504) and internal-error.

503.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504) and internal-error.

504.description: An RFC 9457 problem. Upstream problems are relayed unchanged; the edge adds validation-failed, session-required, malformed-request, payload-too-large, upstream-unavailable (503), gateway-timeout (504) and internal-error.
